home.title: My notebooks
home.emptyDescription: Create a notebook to gather documents, ask questions about them and review with flashcards.
home.noMatchesDescription: No notebook has the selected tags.

notebook.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted or the address is incorrect.

notebooks.createDescription: Give the notebook a name and organize it with tags, if you like.
notebooks.editDescription: Change the notebook's name and tags.
notebooks.deleteDescription: The notebook will be deleted along with its flashcards, documents and conversations. This action cannot be undone.
notebooks.name: Name
notebooks.tagsDescription: Pick existing tags or type the name of a new one.

documents.deleteDescription: “{{filename}}” will no longer be a source for this notebook. This action cannot be undone.
documents.emptyDescription: Add PDFs, Word documents, Markdown, text or audio files to use as chat sources.
documents.uploadDescription: Documents are processed in the background and become sources as soon as they're ready.
documents.dropzone: Drag files here or click to choose
documents.limits: PDF and Word up to 50 MB · Markdown and text up to 10 MB · Audio up to 200 MB
documents.failedToastDescription: Couldn't extract text from “{{filename}}”. Use the reprocess button to try again.

chat.placeholderNoSources: Select at least one source to ask
chat.question: Question
chat.emptyDescription: Ask a question and the answer will come with citations to the selected sources.
chat.clearDescription: All questions and answers in this notebook will be deleted. Documents and flashcards stay as they are.

flashcards.emptyDescription: Create flashcards to review this notebook's content.
flashcards.notebookNotFoundDescription: This notebook doesn't exist or was deleted.
flashcards.createDescription: Write the question on the front and the answer on the back.
flashcards.editDescription: Change the flashcard's front and back.
flashcards.deleteDescription: This flashcard will be deleted and removed from your reviews. This action cannot be undone.
flashcards.howWasIt: How well did you remember the answer?
flashcards.upToDateDescription: No flashcards to review right now. Come back later or create new flashcards.

errors.fallback: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.notFound: The requested resource was not found.
errors.conflict: The operation can't be performed in the current state.
errors.payloadTooLarge: The uploaded file is too large.
errors.unavailable: The service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.notebookInvalid: Check the notebook's name and tags.
errors.documentUnsupported: Unsupported file format or file too large.
errors.documentStorage: Couldn't save the file. Please try again later.
errors.documentBusy: This document is already queued or being processed.
errors.documentTextUnavailable: This document's text isn't available yet.
errors.answerFailed: Couldn't generate the answer. Please try again.
errors.flashcardInvalid: Fill in the flashcard's front and back.
errors.flashcardNotDue: This flashcard isn't available for review yet.
